summary.headline: Saturn’s Easternness and Westernness
summary.text: Discussion of planetary easternness and westernness, including greatest elongation limits for Venus and Mercury, differing strengths of superior and inferior planets, and Aristotle’s account of the Moon’s relation to east and west. Yaʿqūb ibn Isḥāq al-Kindī’s judgments for Saturn cover old age, agriculture, wealth, hardship, and its effects in Aries and Taurus.
